definitions.explanation: A bright, flickering light, as of stars, jewels or light on water.
A brief sign of talent or brilliance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煌|きら}めき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sparkle on the water is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイヤモンド→ダイヤモンド：11038_daiyamondo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煌|きら}めき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}われて→奪う：01895_ubau⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{動|うご}けなかった→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: I was so dazzled by the sparkle of the diamond that I couldn't move for a while.

examples.japanese: ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煌|きら}めき
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知性|ちせい}→知性：13690_chisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煌|きら}めき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: His writing has flashes of intellectual brilliance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦はっとする→ハッとする：16221_hattosuru⟧ような{煌|きら}めき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Now and then the young player's game shows a flash of brilliance that takes your breath away.

notes:
The noun of {煌|きら}めく (to glitter, to sparkle). The kanji {煌|きら} is rare, so the word is very often written in kana: きらめき. Poetic in tone, common in song lyrics and advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煌|きら}めき: the glitter of the stars
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煌|きら}めき: a flash of talent
- ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煌|きら}めき: a momentary sparkle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{輝|かがや}き→輝き：21706_kagayaki⟧: shine, brilliance (steadier light)
- ⟦きらきら→きらきら：05159_kirakira⟧: twinkling, sparkling (onomatopoeia)
